title: THE STAR THAT WANTED A FUNERAL
deck: Oru has lit nine civilizations for six billion years, and now it wants its labour to end. With forty billion lives beneath an eleven-day nova clock, Illuminara must ask for time without turning love into ownership — and help a star design a final gift it remains free to withdraw.
shape: Seven scenes across thirty-two years: an eleven-day stellar emergency, a question asked before any plan, Oru’s self-authored schedule, nine worlds allowed to refuse, a first seed that visibly costs the star, a long sequence of conditional choices, and a final aurora received as a gift rather than a debt.

scenes.title: ELEVEN DAYS
paragraphs: *The Heliarch Ring, inside Oru’s innermost inhabited orbit · eleven days before the projected nova*
Oru filled half the glass, white-centred, a dark spiral tightening every forty-three seconds. Nine worlds revised one number downward: forty billion lives, eleven days, no fleet large enough.
Dr Sera Venn stood among cooling pipes. Ilyan Ro of ocean-world Veya held a recorder of children asking their sun not to die.

**Sera**  
The acceleration is deliberate. Oru is pulling the reaction front inward.

**Ilyan**  
Then speak to it. Tell it we need thirty years.

**Illuminara**  
I will speak to Oru. I will not begin by telling it what its answer must be.

**Ilyan**  
That distinction is beautiful from a body that survives stars.

**Illuminara**  
It is the difference between asking a person for time and claiming that person’s body. We need the first.

**Illuminara**  
Build nine empty gravity cradles there. None closes unless Oru and the receiving world both signal yes. Name the stop before the engine.

**Sera**  
Nine stellar nurseries in eleven days.

**Illuminara**  
Nine places where an answer can become physical. In deep contact my protection folds inward; I cannot hold Oru and repair your machines.
Sera divided the ring’s crews into nine teams. Ilyan set the recorder on the console, unheard.

**Ilyan**  
Ask what ending it wants. Then ask whether there is time inside that ending for us.

**Illuminara**  
In that order.

scenes.title: THE QUESTION BEFORE THE PLAN
paragraphs: *Within Oru’s protected wide encounter · ten days before the projected nova*
Light became pressure and duration: six billion years of fusion, a task with no night shift and no witness who had asked whether the worker wished to continue.
Outside, Sera’s teams moved collectors. Inside, Illuminara could not see them. Three pulses would recall her; one pulse from Oru would end contact immediately.

**Oru**  
You arrive carrying forty billion reasons that I am not allowed to stop.

**Illuminara**  
I carry forty billion lives that need time. I am not bringing them as proof that you belong to them.

**Oru**  
They call me mother, furnace, covenant, calendar. Seven thousand names for what I give and none for the one who gives it.

**Illuminara**  
Oru.
A wave passed through the encounter: a name landing where a function had been.

**Oru**  
Do not make one syllable into absolution.

**Illuminara**  
I will not. What would a good final day feel like?
A violet flare rose and vanished before any telescope could name it. Illuminara felt delight at its unnecessary beauty, and Oru noticed.

**Oru**  
A day in which no one praises my reliability. I want to make one light whose purpose I choose, and then I want no one to ask me to wake again.

**Illuminara**  
What must be true before that day?

**Oru**  
My children must stop needing my body. Dependence is the chain they mistake for love.

**Illuminara**  
You were shaping nine magnetic paths.

**Oru**  
I can send away nine living fires. Each takes part of me that does not return. I did not send them because every world would answer: more, slower, wait. Readiness is the dependent word for never.

**Illuminara**  
Then do not let us choose the schedule.

**Oru**  
You offer gratitude measured in more centuries of consuming my body. If love requires my usefulness, it is a beautiful name for ownership.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. Tell me whether there is a finite farewell you would choose, with an end date no world can extend.
Oru did not soften. Beyond the tightening spiral, the nine paths opened.

scenes.title: ORU’S DATE
paragraphs: *Within the same encounter · nine days, fifteen hours before the projected nova*
Oru assembled nine parcels of stellar mass, nine departure angles and a controlled diminishment ending in every world’s orbital rhythm.

**Oru**  
Thirty-two years. The first fire leaves in nine days. The last leaves when Veya has crossed its ocean thirty-two times. Then I make the aurora, and I end.

**Illuminara**  
Why thirty-two?

**Oru**  
Because I can remain myself through that sequence. Thirty-three turns farewell into employment. Thirty-one leaves the ninth fire unstable.

**Oru**  
Every seed requires my yes. Every world may refuse. If a cradle closes before my signal, the work ends.

**Illuminara**  
You began the eleven-day clock before anyone could answer. That was harm.

**Oru**  
Yes. Every smaller refusal had been placed on a later agenda. I made my no impossible to postpone, and made them hostages to it.

**Illuminara**  
What will you do now?

**Oru**  
I hold the reaction front until the first fire. If anyone violates a release, I stop the seeds; I never point the nova at the worlds again. I keep my right to end. I relinquish their lives as my signal.

**Illuminara**  
The boundary still has heat behind it.

**Oru**  
Yes. Not their deaths in front of it.

**Oru**  
Carry my words without making them kinder. Protect the first fire past the tearing line. Leave later fires to those who live by them.

**Illuminara**  
I choose the first passage. I will not make myself the new star.

**Oru**  
And do not call the fires gifts until I call them gifts.
Three recall pulses struck. Illuminara opened her eyes exactly nine hours after entering. Sera’s hands were black with insulation dust.

**Sera**  
The first cradle can be ready in nine days. Its capture window is unproven.

**Illuminara**  
It stays open unless Oru says yes and you can release safely. Oru chose thirty-two years, no extension. Oru called the clock hostage-taking and surrendered the nova as leverage. Its boundary is stopping the seeds.

**Sera**  
That removes a weapon. It does not remove what the weapon did.

**Illuminara**  
No. Oru told me to carry those words without making them kinder.

**Ilyan**  
I do not forgive eleven days of terror. I accept that the switch is gone and the ending is Oru’s to choose.
Ilyan lifted the recorder and asked permission. Oru’s monitor answered with one pulse: no. Ilyan switched it off.

**Ilyan**  
Then no.

scenes.title: NINE ANSWERS
paragraphs: *The Heliarch Ring and nine receiving skies · seven days before the first seed*
The worlds answered in signals older than Oru’s words. Five said yes. Three requested data. Veya darkened its ocean lamps east to west: no.

**Ilyan**  
Our oceans are tuned to Oru’s tides. We will not accept a new orbit on faith because the old sun is tired.

**Sera**  
Then Veya’s cradle stays open. Habitat places around the fifth world remain yours while you decide.

**Ilyan**  
Forty billion people, and you found room for refusal?

**Sera**  
We designed the stop before the engine. No one has to trust my mood.
Oru’s answer arrived eight minutes later.

**Oru**  
Veya has said no. I heard it.

**Ilyan**  
Are you angry that we said no?

**Oru**  
Yes. I believed you wanted obedience because you wanted it from me. I also used your fear to force an answer.

**Ilyan**  
Then we were both afraid. Only one of us controlled the clock. I am still afraid of losing the sky in which my children know their own faces.

**Oru**  
So am I.
Ilyan placed the silent recorder against the glass and made no request.
Sera’s first cradle linked six thousand harvesters, mirror fleets and mass drivers. Its two vetoes let Oru abort release or Sera open the cradle rather than force a bad capture.

**Sera**  
If drift exceeds three parts in ten thousand, I let it go.

**Illuminara**  
My protection carries the seed only across Oru’s tearing line. After that, its magnetic shell can hold a free trajectory for seconds; a closing cradle is the greater danger. Your machines must give it an orbit.
The three undecided worlds turned their signals to yes. Veya’s lamps remained dark.

scenes.title: THE FIRST FIRE
paragraphs: *Oru’s inner tearing line · fifteen hours before the projected nova*

The first seed rose from Oru, white matter inside a magnetic shell, smaller than a world and heavy enough to bend every measuring beam. As it separated, Oru’s northern corona went dark. Three worlds lost their auroras.
Oru sent the signal. Illuminara protected the seed’s path, not the star or cradle. The force struck her field like a continent falling sideways. Sera’s crews fired the mass drivers.

**Sera**  
Cradle open. Drift two point six. Drivers four and eleven late.

**Illuminara**  
I can hold the passage for nineteen seconds. I cannot correct their timing from here.

**Sera**  
Team four, follow the seed, not the schedule. Team eleven, dump your charge.
The drift rose to two point nine. A cable the width of a building snapped and turned incandescent. The cradle began to close unevenly.

**Oru**  
Open it.

**Sera**  
If I open now, we lose capture.

**Oru**  
Open it.
Sera’s hand hovered over the paired controls. Forty billion lives did not make the seed belong to her. She broke the capture sequence.

**Sera**  
Cradle open. Seed free.

The machinery unfolded. For three seconds the seed moved toward interstellar dark. Its shell steadied; team four matched it with surviving harvesters, and team eleven’s dumped charge became a weaker reference. The seed curved into orbit without the cradle touching it.
The new sun ignited in a blue-white pulse. It was stable. It was also dimmer than the models had promised.

**Sera**  
Fusion holding. Output seventy-one percent. Enough for the first world if its mirrors remain. Not enough to copy the design unchanged.
Illuminara released the passage. The northern corona of Oru did not return. A cool band remained visible across the old star, a missing note written into its body.

**Oru**  
Now you know the fires cost me.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.

**Oru**  
Three years before the next. I will not be hurried because your design was optimistic.

**Sera**  
Three years. We rebuild around what happened, not what we wanted to happen.

The projected nova clock disappeared permanently. Oru spent the inward-drawn reaction front as controlled fuel for the thirty-two-year sequence; it could slow or stop later seeds, but could no longer turn that front back into a nova aimed at the worlds. No one on the ring cheered until the star sent one additional pulse.

**Oru**  
The first fire is a gift.
Only then did the ring answer with light.

scenes.title: THE YEARS THAT COULD STOP
paragraphs: *Taran’s receiver field and Veya’s moon harbour · years five to nineteen after the first seed*

Three new suns were burning when Oru stopped the fourth release. A receiver on Taran had hidden a tap inside its cradle, able to draw directly from Oru if the new sun dimmed. Minister Aro defended it before the nine worlds.

**Aro**  
The first seed gives seventy-one percent. Three billion people live through our long winter. A government that refuses reserve power because a star is weary has confused respect with negligence.

**Oru**  
You connected a pipe to my body after agreeing the cradle would remain open.

**Aro**  
I connected insurance. Your right to stop is exactly why my people cannot depend on your promise.

**Illuminara**  
That fear is real. Hiding the tap does not answer it; it makes Oru’s consent fictional.

**Oru**  
No fourth fire while the tap remains. The old nova switch is gone. I can stop the seeds, and I will not be your secret emergency reserve.

**Aro**  
Then children lose heat this winter.

**Illuminara**  
Then no world should carry that fear alone. Pool surplus mirrors and stored heat beyond Oru’s reach. Every contributing world and Taran holds a veto on withdrawals; independent inspectors see every conduit. Taran gets a reserve that cannot secretly become Oru’s body.

**Aro**  
Guarantee twelve days of stored heat and a winter floor before I dismantle the tap.

**Ilyan**  
Veya contributes tide batteries if Taran exposes the tap today and the reserve can never reach Oru.

**Oru**  
If it cannot touch me, I do not own it. I stop until inspectors see an empty conduit.
Taran exposed the tap that hour. The reserve took forty-two days; for seven weeks Veya and two neighbours held the winter floor. Inspectors found the conduit empty and the reserve sealed.

**Aro**  
The reserve gives us twelve days we can verify. I still do not trust a star free to stop our next sun.

**Oru**  
Then plan for my freedom. If I stop a scheduled release, I will give one Taran year of notice and never begin that notice in your winter. I keep the right to stop; I surrender surprise.

**Aro**  
A promise I can inspect. Not trust. Enough to govern.
Oru resumed. Trust remained conditional, but survival no longer depended on a hidden claim over anyone’s body.
Fourteen years later, Veya remained the ninth refusal. A third had moved to habitats while engineers tested every proposed tide. Ilyan’s hair had gone silver.

**Ilyan**  
Veya says yes now, if you still do. We require a coastal veto over the orbit and no monument claiming you sacrificed yourself for us.

**Oru**  
I want one monument: an empty chair facing the old sunrise. No inscription. People may sit when they want something and leave before asking.

**Ilyan**  
That is a very demanding absence.

**Oru**  
I learned from civilizations.
Illuminara felt the same bright delight as at the violet flare: Oru had made humour without being asked to comfort anyone.

**Ilyan**  
Then Veya says yes.

**Oru**  
I still do.
The ninth team moved its rebuilt cradle. Engineers who had learned from eight imperfect suns carried the work without Illuminara touching it.

scenes.title: THE LAST AURORA
paragraphs: *The empty-chair shore on Veya · thirty-two years after the eleven-day clock*
Nine independent suns held nine inhabited paths. Forty billion people had become more. Children born under the first seed drew Oru gold and crossed by dark bands.

An empty chair faced the old sunrise. Ilyan sat beside it. Sera, walking with a metal brace after a lifetime on the ring, remained at the final control. Illuminara stood where the tide reached her feet.

**Sera**  
All cradles open. No receiver is drawing from Oru. The nine suns are self-sustaining.

**Oru**  
Then the work is finished.

**Ilyan**  
May we play the recording now?

**Oru**  
Yes. Not because it changed my answer.
The children’s voices crossed the beach: frightened, loving, possessive, honest. Oru listened to all one hundred and twelve. When the last said please, a violet flare rose above the horizon.

**Oru**  
They wanted tomorrow. I do not despise them for it.

**Illuminara**  
Do you consent to one final encounter?

**Oru**  
One question. No rescue hidden inside it.
Illuminara opened the protected window. Her reach folded inward; Oru was faint now, but wholly present.

**Illuminara**  
What does your good final day feel like?

**Oru**  
Unscheduled.

The encounter closed by Oru’s choice. The old star released its final pattern through all nine new suns. Auroras rose in different colours and shapes, unsynchronized enough to be no command. People watched, slept, prayed, worked or turned away. No one was ordered to receive the light.
Oru’s centre dimmed. There was no hidden transfer into the seeds and no promise of return. The ancient star ended.
Eight minutes later, the old sunrise failed to arrive. Ilyan placed the recorder on the empty chair and left without asking anything.
Behind him, Veya’s new sun lifted over the ocean — smaller, chosen and sufficient. The aurora remained until noon.

critic_line: Illuminara asks a dying star what a good final day would feel like before she offers any plan, and nine worlds are carried through thirty-two years of conditional yeses and refusals until Oru ends on its own date, unscheduled, with an empty chair facing the old sunrise.

shared_strengths: Fresh premise (a star wanting consent and a funeral) and an ethical, humane resolution with a strong closing line. Dialogue is heavy and abstract, with many near-identical aphoristic exchanges, and the governance mechanics (vetoes, cradles, reserves) read as procedural. Some readers will drift in the middle.

A star asking to stop working is a compelling premise, and the first seed’s launch makes the argument about consent feel like an actual choice under pressure. The empty chair and missing sunrise give readers something to carry away, though the dialogue sometimes restates the theme and the reserve negotiations slow the story.
shared_reservations: No separate improvement instruction was provided beyond Claude’s attributed reader explanation.

translation_sl.title: ZVEZDA, KI SI JE ŽELELA POGREB
translation_sl.deck: Oru že šest milijard let osvetljuje devet civilizacij in zdaj želi, da se njegovo delo konča. Ob štiridesetih milijardah življenj pod enajstdnevnim časom do nove mora Illuminara prositi za čas, ne da bi ljubezen spremenila v lastništvo — in pomagati zvezdi oblikovati zadnje darilo, ki ga lahko še vedno svobodno umakne.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov skozi dvaintrideset let: enajstdnevna zvezdna nevarnost, vprašanje pred vsakim načrtom, Orujev lastni razpored, devet svetov, ki smejo zavrniti, prvo seme, ki zvezdo vidno stane, dolgo zaporedje pogojnih odločitev in zadnji polarni sij, sprejet kot darilo namesto kot dolg.

scenes.title: ENAJST DNI
paragraphs: *Heliarhov obroč, znotraj Orujeve najgloblje naseljene orbite · enajst dni pred napovedano novo*

Oru je zapolnjeval polovico stekla, z belim središčem in temno spiralo, ki se je zategnila vsakih triinštirideset sekund. Devet svetov je eno številko popravljalo navzdol: štirideset milijard življenj, enajst dni, nobena flota ni bila dovolj velika.
Dr. Sera Venn je stala med hladilnimi cevmi. Ilyan Ro z oceanskega sveta Veya je držal posnetek otrok, ki so svoje sonce prosili, naj ne umre.

**Sera**  
Pospeševanje je namerno. Oru vleče reakcijsko fronto navznoter.

**Ilyan**  
Potem govori z njim. Povej mu, da potrebujemo trideset let.

**Illuminara**  
Govorila bom z Orujem. Ne bom začela tako, da mu povem, kakšen mora biti njegov odgovor.

**Ilyan**  
Ta razlika je čudovita iz telesa, ki preživi zvezde.

**Illuminara**  
To je razlika med tem, da nekoga prosimo za čas, in tem, da si lastimo njegovo telo. Potrebujemo prvo.

**Illuminara**  
Tam zgradite devet praznih gravitacijskih zibelk. Nobena se ne zapre, razen če Oru in svet, ki jo sprejema, oba sporočita da. Ustavitev določite pred motorjem.

**Sera**  
Devet zvezdnih porodnišnic v enajstih dneh.

**Illuminara**  
Devet krajev, kjer lahko odgovor postane fizičen. Pri globokem stiku se moja zaščita zvije navznoter; ne morem držati Oruja in popravljati vaših strojev.
Sera je posadke obroča razdelila v devet ekip. Ilyan je neslišani posnetek odložil na konzolo.

**Ilyan**  
Vprašaj, kakšen konec si želi. Potem vprašaj, ali je v tem koncu čas za nas.

**Illuminara**  
V tem vrstnem redu.

scenes.title: VPRAŠANJE PRED NAČRTOM
paragraphs: *Znotraj Orujevega zaščitenega širokega stika · deset dni pred napovedano novo*
Svetloba je postala pritisk in trajanje: šest milijard let zlivanja, naloga brez nočne izmene in brez priče, ki bi kdaj vprašala, ali želi delavec nadaljevati.
Zunaj so Serine ekipe premikale zbiralnike. Znotraj jih Illuminara ni mogla videti. Trije sunki bi jo priklicali nazaj; en sam Orujev sunek bi stik takoj končal.

**Oru**  
Prihajaš s štiridesetimi milijardami razlogov, zaradi katerih se ne smem ustaviti.

**Illuminara**  
Prinašam štirideset milijard življenj, ki potrebujejo čas. Ne prinašam jih kot dokaz, da jim pripadaš.

**Oru**  
Kličejo me mati, peč, zaveza, koledar. Sedem tisoč imen za to, kar dajem, in nobenega za tistega, ki to daje.

**Illuminara**  
Oru.
Skozi stik je šel val: ime je pristalo tam, kjer je bila prej funkcija.

**Oru**  
Ne spreminjaj enega zloga v odvezo.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom. Kakšen občutek bi imel dober zadnji dan?
Vijoličen izbruh se je dvignil in izginil, preden bi ga lahko poimenoval kateri koli teleskop. Illuminara je ob njegovi nepotrebni lepoti začutila veselje in Oru je to opazil.

**Oru**  
Dan, ko nihče ne hvali moje zanesljivosti. Ustvariti želim eno svetlobo, katere namen izberem sam, potem pa želim, da me nihče več ne prosi, naj se zbudim.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj mora biti res, preden pride ta dan?

**Oru**  
Moji otroci morajo prenehati potrebovati moje telo. Odvisnost je veriga, ki jo zamenjujejo za ljubezen.

**Illuminara**  
Oblikoval si devet magnetnih poti.

**Oru**  
Lahko odpošljem devet živih ognjev. Vsak odnese del mene, ki se ne vrne. Nisem jih poslal, ker bi vsak svet odgovoril: več, počasneje, počakaj. Pripravljenost je beseda odvisnih za nikoli.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ne dovoli, da mi izberemo razpored.

**Oru**  
Ponujaš hvaležnost, izmerjeno v dodatnih stoletjih porabljanja mojega telesa. Če ljubezen zahteva mojo uporabnost, je lepo ime za lastništvo.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Povej mi, ali bi izbral omejeno slovo s končnim datumom, ki ga noben svet ne more podaljšati.
Oru se ni omehčal. Onkraj zategujoče se spirale se je odprlo devet poti.

scenes.title: ORUJEV DATUM
paragraphs: *Znotraj istega stika · devet dni in petnajst ur pred napovedano novo*
Oru je sestavil devet pošiljk zvezdne snovi, devet kotov odhoda in nadzorovano pojemanje, ki se je končalo v orbitalnem ritmu vsakega sveta.

**Oru**  
Dvaintrideset let. Prvi ogenj odide čez devet dni. Zadnji odide, ko bo Veya dvaintridesetkrat prečkala svoj ocean. Potem ustvarim polarni sij in se končam.

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj dvaintrideset?

**Oru**  
Ker lahko skozi to zaporedje ostanem jaz. Triintrideset spremeni slovo v zaposlitev. Enaintrideset pusti deveti ogenj nestabilen.

**Oru**  
Vsako seme potrebuje moj da. Vsak svet lahko zavrne. Če se zibelka zapre pred mojim signalom, se delo konča.

**Illuminara**  
Enajstdnevno uro si sprožil, preden je lahko kdorkoli odgovoril. To je bilo škodovanje.

**Oru**  
Da. Vsaka manjša zavrnitev je bila uvrščena na poznejši dnevni red. Svoj ne sem naredil takega, da ga ni bilo mogoče odložiti, njih pa sem spremenil v njegove talce.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj boš storil zdaj?

**Oru**  
Reakcijsko fronto zadržim do prvega ognja. Če kdo krši izpust, ustavim semena; nove nikoli več ne usmerim proti svetovom. Ohranim pravico do konca. Njihova življenja ne bodo več moj signal.

**Illuminara**  
Za mejo je še vedno vročina.

**Oru**  
Da. Ne pa njihove smrti pred njo.

**Oru**  
Prenesi moje besede, ne da bi jih olepšala. Zaščiti prvi ogenj čez razdiralno mejo. Poznejše ognje prepusti tistim, ki živijo ob njih.

**Illuminara**  
Izberem prvi prehod. Ne bom se spremenila v novo zvezdo.

**Oru**  
In ognjev ne imenuj darila, dokler jih tako ne imenujem jaz.
Udarili so trije sunki za priklic. Illuminara je odprla oči natanko devet ur po vstopu. Serine roke so bile črne od izolacijskega prahu.

**Sera**  
Prva zibelka je lahko pripravljena v devetih dneh. Njeno okno za zajem ni preizkušeno.

**Illuminara**  
Ostane odprta, razen če Oru reče da in jo lahko varno sprostite. Oru je izbral dvaintrideset let, brez podaljšanja. Uro je imenoval jemanje talcev in se odrekel novi kot vzvodu. Njegova meja je ustavitev semen.

**Sera**  
S tem je odstranjeno orožje. Ni pa odstranjeno, kar je orožje storilo.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Oru mi je naročil, naj te besede prenesem, ne da bi jih olepšala.

**Ilyan**  
Enajstih dni groze ne odpuščam. Sprejmem, da stikala ni več in da konec izbira Oru.
Ilyan je dvignil snemalnik in vprašal za dovoljenje. Orujev monitor je odgovoril z enim sunkom: ne. Ilyan ga je ugasnil.

**Ilyan**  
Potem ne.

scenes.title: DEVET ODGOVOROV
paragraphs: *Heliarhov obroč in devet sprejemnih nebes · sedem dni pred prvim semenom*
Svetovi so odgovorili s signali, starejšimi od Orujevih besed. Pet jih je reklo da. Trije so zahtevali podatke. Veya je od vzhoda proti zahodu zatemnila svoje oceanske luči: ne.

**Ilyan**  
Naši oceani so uglašeni na Orujevo plimovanje. Nove orbite ne bomo sprejeli na slepo samo zato, ker je staro sonce utrujeno.

**Sera**  
Potem Veyina zibelka ostane odprta. Mesta v habitatih okoli petega sveta ostanejo vaša, medtem ko se odločate.

**Ilyan**  
Štirideset milijard ljudi, pa ste našli prostor za zavrnitev?

**Sera**  
Ustavitev smo zasnovali pred motorjem. Nikomur ni treba zaupati mojemu razpoloženju.
Orujev odgovor je prispel osem minut pozneje.

**Oru**  
Veya je rekla ne. Slišal sem jo.

**Ilyan**  
Si jezen, ker smo rekli ne?

**Oru**  
Da. Verjel sem, da želite poslušnost, ker ste jo hoteli od mene. Tudi jaz sem uporabil vaš strah, da sem izsilil odgovor.

**Ilyan**  
Potem sva se bala oba. Samo eden od naju je nadzoroval uro. Še vedno me je strah, da izgubim nebo, na katerem moji otroci prepoznajo svoje obraze.

**Oru**  
Tudi mene.
Ilyan je tihi snemalnik prislonil ob steklo in ni ničesar prosil.

Serina prva zibelka je povezala šest tisoč zbiralnikov, flot zrcal in masnih gonilnikov. Njeni dve pravici veta sta Oruju omogočili prekinitev izpusta, Seri pa odprtje zibelke, namesto da bi izsilila slab zajem.

**Sera**  
Če odklon preseže tri desettisočinke, ga izpustim.

**Illuminara**  
Moja zaščita prenese seme samo čez Orujevo razdiralno mejo. Nato lahko njegov magnetni ovoj nekaj sekund ohranja prosto tirnico; zapirajoča se zibelka je večja nevarnost. Vaši stroji mu morajo dati orbito.
Trije neodločeni svetovi so svoje signale preklopili na da. Veyine luči so ostale temne.

scenes.title: PRVI OGENJ
paragraphs: *Orujeva notranja razdiralna meja · petnajst ur pred napovedano novo*

Prvo seme se je dvignilo iz Oruja, bela snov v magnetnem ovoju, manjša od sveta in dovolj težka, da je ukrivila vsak merilni žarek. Ko se je ločila, je Orujeva severna korona potemnela. Trije svetovi so izgubili polarni sij.
Oru je poslal signal. Illuminara je zaščitila pot semena, ne zvezde ali zibelke. Sila je zadela njeno polje kakor celina, ki pada postrani. Serine posadke so sprožile masne gonilnike.

**Sera**  
Zibelka odprta. Odklon dva cela šest. Gonilnika štiri in enajst zamujata.

**Illuminara**  
Prehod lahko držim devetnajst sekund. Od tukaj ne morem popravljati njihovega časa.

**Sera**  
Ekipa štiri, sledite semenu, ne urniku. Ekipa enajst, izpraznite svoj naboj.
Odklon je narasel na dva cela devet. Kabel, širok kakor stavba, se je pretrgal in zažarel. Zibelka se je začela neenakomerno zapirati.

**Oru**  
Odpri jo.

**Sera**  
Če jo zdaj odprem, izgubimo zajem.

**Oru**  
Odpri jo.
Serina roka je obstala nad seznanjenima krmiloma. Štirideset milijard življenj ni pomenilo, da seme pripada njej. Prekinila je zaporedje zajema.

**Sera**  
Zibelka odprta. Seme prosto.

Stroji so se razprli. Tri sekunde se je seme premikalo proti medzvezdni temi. Njegov ovoj se je umiril; ekipa štiri se je z njim uskladila s preživelimi zbiralniki, izpraznjeni naboj ekipe enajst pa je postal šibkejša referenca. Seme je zavilo v orbito, ne da bi se ga zibelka dotaknila.
Novo sonce se je prižgalo v modro-belem sunku. Bilo je stabilno. Bilo je tudi temnejše, kot so obljubljali modeli.

**Sera**  
Zlivanje drži. Moč enainsedemdeset odstotkov. Dovolj za prvi svet, če njegova zrcala ostanejo. Premalo, da bi načrt nespremenjen kopirali.
Illuminara je spustila prehod. Orujeva severna korona se ni vrnila. Hladen pas je ostal viden čez staro zvezdo, manjkajoča nota, zapisana v njeno telo.

**Oru**  
Zdaj veste, da me ognji stanejo.

**Illuminara**  
Da.

**Oru**  
Tri leta do naslednjega. Ne bom se pustil priganjati, ker je bil vaš načrt optimističen.

**Sera**  
Tri leta. Znova gradimo okoli tega, kar se je zgodilo, ne okoli tega, kar smo želeli.

Napovedana ura do nove je za vedno izginila. Oru je navznoter potegnjeno reakcijsko fronto porabil kot nadzorovano gorivo za dvaintridesetletno zaporedje; poznejša semena je lahko upočasnil ali ustavil, vendar fronte ni mogel več spremeniti nazaj v novo, usmerjeno proti svetovom. Nihče na obroču ni vzkliknil, dokler zvezda ni poslala še enega sunka.

**Oru**  
Prvi ogenj je darilo.
Šele tedaj je obroč odgovoril s svetlobo.

scenes.title: LETA, KI SO SE LAHKO USTAVILA
paragraphs: *Taranovo sprejemno polje in Veyino lunino pristanišče · od petega do devetnajstega leta po prvem semenu*

Ko je Oru ustavil četrti izpust, so gorela tri nova sonca. Sprejemnik na Taranu je v svojo zibelko skril priključek, ki je lahko črpal neposredno iz Oruja, če bi novo sonce potemnelo. Minister Aro ga je zagovarjal pred devetimi svetovi.

**Aro**  
Prvo seme daje enainsedemdeset odstotkov. Tri milijarde ljudi preživljajo našo dolgo zimo. Vlada, ki zavrne rezervno energijo, ker je zvezda utrujena, je spoštovanje zamenjala za malomarnost.

**Oru**  
Na moje telo ste priključili cev, potem ko ste se strinjali, da bo zibelka ostala odprta.

**Aro**  
Priključil sem zavarovanje. Prav tvoja pravica, da se ustaviš, pomeni, da moji ljudje ne morejo biti odvisni od tvoje obljube.

**Illuminara**  
Ta strah je resničen. Skrivalnica priključka mu ne odgovori; Orujevo soglasje naredi navidezno.

**Oru**  
Četrtega ognja ne bo, dokler priključek ostaja. Staro stikalo za novo je odstranjeno. Lahko ustavim semena in ne bom vaša skrivna rezerva v sili.

**Aro**  
Potem bodo otroci to zimo izgubili toploto.

**Illuminara**  
Potem noben svet ne bi smel sam nositi tega strahu. Združite presežna zrcala in shranjeno toploto zunaj Orujevega dosega. Vsak sodelujoči svet in Taran imata veto na črpanje; neodvisni inšpektorji vidijo vsak vod. Taran dobi rezervo, ki ne more skrivaj postati zahteva po Orujevem telesu.

**Aro**  
Zagotovite dvanajst dni shranjene toplote in zimski minimum, preden odstranim priključek.

**Ilyan**  
Veya prispeva plimske baterije, če Taran danes razkrije priključek in rezerva nikoli ne more doseči Oruja.

**Oru**  
Če se me ne more dotakniti, si je ne lastim. Ustavim se, dokler inšpektorji ne vidijo praznega voda.

Taran je tisto uro razkril priključek. Rezervo so zgradili v dvainštiridesetih dneh; sedem tednov so Veya in dve sosedi vzdrževale zimski minimum. Inšpektorji so ugotovili, da je vod prazen in rezerva zapečatena.

**Aro**  
Rezerva nam daje dvanajst dni, ki jih lahko preverimo. Še vedno ne zaupam zvezdi, ki lahko ustavi naše naslednje sonce.

**Oru**  
Potem načrtuj za mojo svobodo. Če ustavim načrtovani izpust, bom opozoril eno taransko leto vnaprej in opozorila nikoli ne bom začel v vaši zimi. Ohranil bom pravico do ustavitve; odrekel se bom presenečenju.

**Aro**  
Obljuba, ki jo lahko preverim. Ne zaupanje. Dovolj za upravljanje.
Oru je nadaljeval. Zaupanje je ostalo pogojno, vendar preživetje ni bilo več odvisno od skrite zahteve po telesu kogar koli.
Štirinajst let pozneje je Veya ostala deveta zavrnitev. Tretjina se jih je preselila v habitate, medtem ko so inženirji preizkušali vsako predlagano plimovanje. Ilyanovi lasje so osiveli.

**Ilyan**  
Veya zdaj pravi da, če ga še vedno praviš tudi ti. Zahtevamo obalni veto nad orbito in nobenega spomenika, ki bi trdil, da si se žrtvoval za nas.

**Oru**  
Želim en spomenik: prazen stol, obrnjen proti staremu sončnemu vzhodu. Brez napisa. Ljudje lahko sedejo, ko nekaj želijo, in odidejo, preden vprašajo.

**Ilyan**  
To je zelo zahtevna odsotnost.

**Oru**  
Naučil sem se od civilizacij.
Illuminara je začutila isto svetlo veselje kakor ob vijoličnem izbruhu: Oru se je pošalil, ne da bi ga kdo prosil, naj koga potolaži.

**Ilyan**  
Potem Veya pravi da.

**Oru**  
Jaz ga še vedno pravim.
Deveta ekipa je premaknila svojo prenovljeno zibelko. Inženirji, ki so se učili ob osmih nepopolnih soncih, so opravili delo, ne da bi se ga Illuminara dotaknila.

scenes.title: ZADNJI POLARNI SIJ
paragraphs: *Obala praznega stola na Veyi · dvaintrideset let po enajstdnevni uri*
Devet neodvisnih sonc je držalo devet naseljenih poti. Štirideset milijard ljudi je postalo več. Otroci, rojeni pod prvim semenom, so Oruja risali zlatega in prečrtanega s temnimi pasovi.

Prazen stol je bil obrnjen proti staremu sončnemu vzhodu. Ilyan je sedel poleg njega. Sera, ki je po življenju na obroču hodila s kovinsko opornico, je ostala pri zadnjem krmilu. Illuminara je stala tam, kjer ji je plima dosegla stopala.

**Sera**  
Vse zibelke so odprte. Noben sprejemnik ne črpa iz Oruja. Devet sonc je samozadostnih.

**Oru**  
Potem je delo končano.

**Ilyan**  
Smemo zdaj predvajati posnetek?

**Oru**  
Da. Ne zato, ker bi spremenil moj odgovor.
Otroški glasovi so prečkali plažo: prestrašeni, ljubeči, posesivni, iskreni. Oru je poslušal vseh sto dvanajst. Ko je zadnji rekel prosim, se je nad obzorjem dvignil vijoličen izbruh.

**Oru**  
Želeli so si jutri. Zaradi tega jih ne zaničujem.

**Illuminara**  
Ali soglašaš z enim zadnjim stikom?

**Oru**  
Eno vprašanje. Brez rešitve, skrite v njem.
Illuminara je odprla zaščiteno okno. Njen doseg se je zvil navznoter; Oru je bil zdaj šibek, vendar povsem prisoten.

**Illuminara**  
Kakšen občutek ima tvoj dober zadnji dan?

**Oru**  
Nenačrtovan.

Stik se je končal po Orujevi izbiri. Stara zvezda je skozi vseh devet novih sonc sprostila svoj zadnji vzorec. Polarni siji so se dvignili v različnih barvah in oblikah, dovolj neusklajeni, da niso bili ukaz. Ljudje so gledali, spali, molili, delali ali se obrnili stran. Nikomur ni bilo ukazano sprejeti svetlobe.
Orujevo središče je potemnelo. V semenih ni bilo skritega prenosa in nobene obljube vrnitve. Starodavna zvezda se je končala.
Osem minut pozneje starega sončnega vzhoda ni bilo. Ilyan je snemalnik odložil na prazen stol in odšel, ne da bi karkoli prosil.
Za njim se je nad oceanom dvignilo Veyino novo sonce — manjše, izbrano in zadostno. Polarni sij je ostal do poldneva.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara umirajočo zvezdo vpraša, kakšen naj bi bil dober zadnji dan, še preden ponudi kakršen koli načrt, devet svetov pa nato skozi dvaintrideset let pogojnih privolitev in zavrnitev spremlja Oru, dokler se ta na datum po lastni izbiri, brez urnika, ne konča ob praznem stolu, obrnjenem proti staremu sončnemu vzhodu.
